text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-007","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"# MATERIAL : M.S."}],"comment":"Mild steel is specified for a shaft, but mild steel lacks the strength and wear resistance typically required for shaft applications. The designer should select an appropriate medium-carbon or alloy steel suited to the shaft's loading and wear conditions.","recommended_correction":"Change note N5 to specify a material with adequate strength and wear resistance for a shaft (e.g., EN8, AISI 1045, or equivalent)."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"10±0.1"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D2","page":1,"quote":"20±0.2"}],"comment":"The stepped diameters on this shaft carry only general ± tolerances rather than fit callouts, yet shafts are functional mating features that must interface with bearings, bushings, or hubs. Without proper fit designations, assembly function cannot be guaranteed. The designer should add appropriate fit or tolerance class callouts to all mating diameters.","recommended_correction":"Add fit callouts (e.g., h6, g6) or specific toleranced limits to the shaft diameters that serve as bearing seats or other mating features."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH : I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D6","page":1,"quote":"200±0.02"}],"comment":"A plating/coating finish is specified but the tight-tolerance dimensions do not account for the added coating thickness, which will cause mating fits to be out of spec after finishing. The designer must either allow for plating thickness in the pre-plate machining dimensions or explicitly state that tolerances apply after plating.","recommended_correction":"Revise the tight-tolerance dimensions to account for the I.Z.B.P. plating thickness, or add a note specifying that the stated tolerances apply after plating."}]}
